description: Shows which agent threads wait on your answer or failed, pinned above your thread list, so none of them sit unnoticed. Open one with a click, ⇧⌘J for the next, or ⌥⌘1–9 by its row; a thread leaves the block once you open it. Each question shows when it was asked, and counters in the title track waiting, failed, finished, and working threads. Pick a style, or tune markers, colors, row layout, and row limits on a settings page with a live preview, then move the setup between machines as JSON. Runs on your bb server only, with no account, API key, or outside service.
